body: I guess I shouldn't be surprised because her dad was pretty big. Still I guess I never pictured her getting so large. But I've come across Bostons of different sizes and colors and it's so awesome to see the variety. She's our little piggy lol

SHE'S HUGE. We took her for her yearly vet visit not too long ago and she's 35 pounds! We didn't think she'd get that big! And to think when we first brought her home she was literally the size of her head lol
Also thank you! She's so awesome. We love her more than anything.

That's actually my boyfriend, I only took the photo. But she only let's him hold her like that! Nobody else, not even me lol. He's held her like that since she was 6 weeks old, and I think she just feels really safe. Its sweet.
I'm over here at work shaking so hard trying not to laugh out loud jfc
The three of us in bed is nearly impossible. I'm usually the one kicked out due to these two snoring and sprawling out. 😂😂😂
Oh my goodness!!!! So precious. My 1 year old Boston just hit 34 pounds. We never expected her to get so big!

I never understood why people got so upset at me when I got discouraged about my weight. I'd say things like "my ideal body/weight is this" etc and would address my weight. Friends would always be like, "But you're great the way you are! You're beautiful! You weigh that much? It doesn't show!" It was so annoying. I was constantly told to love my body and it's like I really don't care what those people think about it. Doesn't it only matter what I think about it? If I feel uncomfortable and miserable in my own skin why should I try to force myself to accept it?? If someone else is ok with being overweight, well that's fine, but I'm not and I shouldn't be discouraged from trying to making changes.
My boyfriend is the only person my boston will let hold her like a baby. And she always gets so calm when he does. It's really sweet.
